items.t: L3Harris Technologies (LHX) Router Outage Puts Air Traffic Upgrades In Focus
items.sum: L3Harris Technologies (NYSE:LHX) is under scrutiny after an FAA system outage was tied to a router software upgrade supplied by the contractor. The disruption triggered nationwide flight delays and cancellations as air traffic control centers relied on manual procedures during the outage.
